title: Game-Theoretic Co-Evolution for LLM-Based Heuristic Discovery

mechanism.domainTask: Game-theoretic co-evolution of heuristic solver programs and instance-generator programs for combinatorial optimization
mechanism.populationDetail: ASRO maintains growing flat strategy pools for solvers and generators, while each best-response oracle also has a bounded flat population; no islands or tree organization are described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is specified; persistent strategy pools and inner TOP-K populations are the maintained search structures.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Outer solver/generator pools expand by insertion, while inner oracle populations retain the TOP-K from parents plus offspring.
mechanism.generationDetail: I1 generates from scratch; E1 makes broad divergent variants; E2 recombines ideas from multiple parents; M1 semantically refines, M2 locally tunes parameters, and M3 simplifies one parent.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Per-opponent payoff estimates are weighted by the opponent meta-strategy and used in the payoff matrix, meta-game solution, and candidate fitness-based selection.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: A parent set of user-defined size p is sampled from the current inner population according to fitness and diversity; exact p and sampling distribution are not specified.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: A second evolving population consists of executable instance-generator programs, creating a zero-sum meta-game and self-generated evaluation curriculum alongside solver evolution.
